correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed both necessary-and-sufficient correspondence arguments for every nonempty partially ordered W. For arbitrary atomic upsets A,B,C, the two nested existential semantics are exactly intersection of the upward product with L_R(u) and M_R(u). Principal upsets separate unequal downward closures. For bullet, the u-output-saturated relation E absorbs quantification over v≥u; distributivity gives a universal disjunctive predicate on triples of L_E and M_E. Complements of principal downsets separate unequal upward closures. Kaminski monotonicity (ii) makes E input-upward and hence both composites upsets, yielding literal L_E=M_E. Enumeration of n worlds × n³ candidate triples × n³ generating triples proves conservative O(n^7) time/O(n^4) space. Independently programmed full semantic-versus-relational checks matched on 2 admitted one-world, 67 admitted two-chain, 256 two-antichain, and 95 admitted functional three-chain frames. Finite checks corroborate, but the full result uses the symbolic principal-upset separation proof; no strong-completeness claim.

value.rationale: Associativity in the 2026 intuitionistic binary-modal semantics motivates a natural fixed-frame validity characterization. The result is a useful structural characterization, not merely a numerical small-case check.
